assumptions: A fixed code bank no person-varying fallback/metadata; if present, prelock META reader and revise counts before fit
B metadata constant within arm/seed; public DA transform exists

C seven approved C-SIMPLE fixed-mask/retraining arms; old C-JOINT/C-INDEP premise-failed slots and incompatible prior selector skipped; DA_MLP gets distinct public-head recomputation from selected raw features
D code onehot and ten bits in complete x; three external direct-cell alphas with structured fallback; D beta arm IDs pending team confirmation
Null/shuffled/planted engineering fits additional by distinct wire-builder schema; no Adult science fit yet
C two extra fresh raw-selected-values-only readers per local/pair view: RAW_LR_C1 and RAW_HGB_15x200, same for all seven arms
Historical T*, P*, lra D0 SEQ-21 get fresh ATTACK_FIT_NEW fixed complete-view attacks; no historic attack alias. Their role-only bank outputs require S4/S3 admission.
B-RAW-TASK is a distinct deterministic raw-task bottleneck release and receives 12 fresh reader fits/seed; no B-TASK attack alias

A class-only floor discloses each inherited U0 decision as class ID and one-hot probability, with fixed complete-view five-reader slate; empirical fitted AUC is a lower-capability estimate, while ideal-reader data-processing floor is a structural statement; confidence utility measured but presumptively ineligible

Hcal D0 LOCAL .1 and SEQ-12 .1 are fresh contextual source controls from SOURCE_ADMISSION-pinned policy JSON; they do not have held-out H-GLOBAL decoder packages and are not capacity/calibration-matched to new A channels
